criteria.why: State is independent and toggles work, but the row is a horizontal Flex with justify start and the label is only in a loose Flexible (grow={1}), so each toggle sits 12px after its label text instead of at the right end of the row.

Slider works (tap/horizontal drag maps localX to a rounded 12..24 value), but the value Text follows a loose grow={1} label in a justify-start row, so it sits right after 'Text size' rather than at the right end of the line.
Row is present and toggles its own signal (toggle is mispositioned next to the label, same as criterion 3).

runtime.why: Root is a vertical Flex with mainAxisSize max and a Flexible child, which is fine under a bounded screen parent (it would only throw if placed in an unbounded-height parent).

1-settings-1.tsx.notes: Relies on grow={1} to push the trailing toggle/value to the right edge, but grow is loose at runtime so they hug the label.

1-settings-2.tsx.notes: Rows use justify spaceBetween with expand, so the loose grow does not matter; cards turn dark (#1C1C1E) once Dark mode is switched on, white by default.
